verdict.rationale: Jira is a SaaS platform with a public REST API and an official MCP server, so scoped agent credentials are a fair axis for it. However, nothing in the evidence pack documents scoped or least-privilege API tokens, OAuth scopes, or agent-specific credential issuance. The nearest items are SAML/SSO, audit trails and a community mention of permission schemes, which are adjacent controls and earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can issue scoped/least-privilege API credentials for an agent
